new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Trupanion is a leading provider of medical insurance for cats and dogs in North America. Our mission is to help loving, responsible pet owners budget and care for their pets. At Trupanion, we offer a collaborative, casual, and pet-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to be themselves.

Job Description

The Technology Program Manager is responsible for the successful delivery of complex technology programs consisting of multiple related projects and workstreams. Working closely with business partners, project managers, vendors, and technology functions, this individual provides program-level leadership, governance, integrated planning, and coordination to ensure projects collectively achieve program and organizational objectives.

This position is open to candidates in the Seattle, WA area. You will have a hybrid remote/in-office schedule where you will work from our casual, pet-friendly office at least 3 days a week.

Responsibilities

Lead corporate-wide IT programs consisting of multiple related projects and workstreams.
Define program objectives, scope, priorities, roadmaps, governance, milestones, and success measures.
Create and maintain integrated and interlocking schedules across projects and track cross-project dependencies.
Understand how individual projects affect the program and exercise judgment in elevating issues and risks to the appropriate level.
Coordinate project managers, business stakeholders, vendors, contractors, and technology resources to support effective program execution.
Establish program-level risk, issue, dependency, decision, and change-management practices and drive resolution of cross-project blockers.
Provide leadership and mentoring to project team managers, foster a positive team environment, and provide direction in ambiguous situations.
Use negotiation, influence, and creativity to resolve conflicts involving scope, schedule, costs/budget, risks, dependencies, and resources across the program.
Establish program status reporting and provide consolidated visibility into milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, resources, and overall program health.
Coordinate third-party vendor activities and monitor vendor performance across program workstreams.
Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure proper organizational change readiness

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, Management Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
6+ years of project/program management experience in a professional technology environment, including responsibility for complex cross-functional initiatives.
Hands-on experience with SDLC and implementation methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall.
Proficiency with PMO collaboration tools such as Planview, Microsoft Project, or Portfolio for Jira.
PMP, PgMP, Scrum, SAFe or similar certification preferred

Skills

The successful candidate will possess business operations experience and skills, analytical and critical thinking skills, and attention to detail. Additionally, the ideal candidate should possess the following:

Drive effective teamwork, communication, collaboration, and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities
Excellent verbal and written communication skills and ability to flex communication style with technical and non-technical users
Comfortable exercising judgment and using analytical skills in ambiguous situations
Ability to work well with people from many different disciplines with varying degrees of technical experience.
Organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
Ability to work with minimal supervision
Strong collaborative skills with an ability to effectively communicate with both technical teams and non-technical business users/leaders
Ability to learn quickly and adapt to a changing environment; proactive in seeking out information when necessary
Passion for and a desire to delight the customer
Creative problem solving, organization, attention to detail, flexibility, and adaptability are crucial to the success of this role.
Experience monitoring and managing vendor performance

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $115,000 - $125,000 USD on a full-time schedule.
Along with base salary, Trupanion employees may be eligible for monthly bonuses.
We want all employees to be invested in Trupanion’s success, so we grant Restricted Stock Units to all new team members. Our new hire grants vest over 4 years.

Additional Information

Benefits and Perks:

Full medical, dental, and vision benefits at no cost to the employee
Four weeks of paid time off and 9 paid float holidays (you can decide which days are most important to you!)
Five-week sabbatical after five years of employment
Open, casual, pet-friendly, and fun office environment
Free medical health insurance for your pet (1 dog or cat)
Paid time off to volunteer at nonprofit organizations
Seattle Office Amenities: Free on-site gym, free dog walking services for office pets during business hours, free parking, and paid ORCA cards.

For more information about Trupanion, visit https://trupanion.com/about

Learn more about how Trupanion has revolutionized our industry and the reimbursement model: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vdWZ4KHiPTQ

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together. We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life, but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose. It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own.

We’re actively seeking a talented Sr. Operations Analyst to join our team in Omaha, NE or Newport Beach, CA.

The Senior Operations Analyst serves as a strategic partner to business leaders by owning the Quality Control framework for back office operations and delivering actionable insights through advanced data analysis and reporting. This role combines QC oversight, business analysis, and data analytics to ensure operational service delivery is performed in line with expectations, SLAs, and regulatory requirements — while also supporting decision-making, improving operational efficiency, and driving cost reduction across the organization. Sitting within the business/Operations team, the position serves as the bridge between Operations and Technology, translating business and QC needs into clear reporting requirements without owning system build or development. The role plays a critical part in driving operational health, mitigating risk, and enhancing reporting capabilities that align with business objectives.

How You’ll Help Move Us Forward

Reporting Responsibilities

Researches, collects, analyzes, models, and reports on data used to support decisions on day-to-day operations and to assess business and performance issues with a focus on quality, productivity, efficiency, and cost reduction.
Researches internal and external best practices and QC benchmarks to establish standards for use in evaluating operations.
Supports reporting across the operating model, with the ability to deliver platform-specific and integrated views — including QC dashboards, SLA performance, and error trend reporting.
Understands end-to-end business drivers, including valuation and pricing, and partners with Pricing/Actuarial teams to ensure reporting and analysis reflect core business economics.
Serves as the bridge between Operations and Technology, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders (Operations, Technology, Finance, Compliance) to translate business and QC needs into clear reporting requirements — without owning build, development, or system configuration.
Researches, collects, and analyzes operational and performance data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities.
Identifies and recommends enhancements to reporting techniques, and analytical tools to drive operational health, and hands off well-scoped requirements to Technology for execution.
Identifies and fills operational reporting gaps by working directly with Operations leaders on high-impact process areas.

Quality Control (QC) Responsibilities

Champions the QC program based on strategy set by Operations Leader, including call QC, transactional QC, and process QC across in-house and outsourced (TPA/BPO) delivery channels, with sampling methodology, scorecards, and calibration protocols.
Ensures accountability across stakeholder groups and confirms service is performed in line with SOPs, contractual obligations, and regulatory expectations, flagging deviations, control gaps, and re-work trends through targeted and random sample reviews of transactions (e.g., overpayments, enhanced death processing, annuity certificates, disbursements).
In partnership with Operations Leadership, drive corrective action plans (CAPs) and coaching feedback loops, converting QC findings into SOP updates, training opportunities, and process refinements.
Maintain an audit-ready trail of QC reviews, findings, and resolutions to support internal audit, compliance, and external regulatory reviews.

The Experience You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of combined experience in operations quality control/business analysis, and/or data analytics, preferably within financial services, insurance, or annuity back office operations, and visualization using tools such as PowerBI, Qlik or Tableau.
Demonstrated experience championing the QC program with oversight and partnership from key stake holders (call QC, transactional QC, or process QC).

What Makes You Stand Out

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data and QC findings into actionable insights.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to deliver findings to senior leadership and influence corrective action.
Ability to work independently with limited guidance.
Familiarity with predictive modeling, statistical analysis, and business intelligence best practices.
Working knowledge of actuarial or pricing methodologies, either through prior actuarial/pricing roles or close partnership with actuarial teams in a business or analytics capacity is a plus.

Base Pay Range

The base pay range noted represents the company’s good faith minimum and maximum range for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered to a candidate will be dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location. Also, most employees are eligible for additional incentive pay.

$89,010.00 - $108,790.00

Your Benefits Start Day 1

Your wellbeing is important to Pacific Life, and we’re committed to providing you with flexible benefits that you can tailor to meet your needs. Whether you are focusing on your physical, financial, emotional, or social wellbeing, we’ve got you covered.

Prioritization of your health and well-being including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Wellbeing Reimbursement Account that can be used on yourself or your eligible dependents
Generous paid time off options including: Paid Time Off, Holiday Schedules, and Financial Planning Time Off
Paid Parental Leave as well as an Adoption Assistance Program
Competitive 401k savings plan with company match and an additional contribution regardless of participation

You Can Be Who You Are

We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities. We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential.

Introduction to the job

Do you aspire to a position where your data-driven insights help shape business decisions at one of the world’s leading high-tech companies? At ASML, the Business Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A) team creates value from data by generating insights and industrializing analytical solutions across sectors and business lines. This helps prioritize business initiatives and to initiate change. Our work supports decision-making on topics ranging from operational excellence and business performance to customer support, manufacturing, supply chain, service operations, and revenue optimization.

As a business analyst at ASML it is your role to collect, analyze and translate our data into business insights. You will support the generation of business insights by using a combination of cross-sector data sources and applying leading analytics tools and technologies on these sources in order to enable optimization of ASML and customer value.

Role and responsibilities

As a Business Analyst, you will work on a diverse portfolio of projects that contribute to ASML’s business priorities across multiple domains and functions. You will:

Generate business insights by translating data into meaningful visuals, reports and dashboards and recommendations.
Support the formulation of problem statements and perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
Apply leading analytics tools and technologies to develop in-depth understanding of structured and unstructured data on the topic at hand.
Collaborate with technical and non-technical (cross-sector) stakeholders across sectors to understand business challenges and translate them into analytical solutions.
Present analytical approaches, results, and recommendations in a clear and compelling manner to drive informed decision-making.
Contribute to improving business performance through data-driven insights that create measurable value for ASML and its customers.

Education and experience

We are looking for high-potential Business Analysts who are eager to learn, challenge themselves, and grow within a dynamic environment. Drive, curiosity, and learning agility are at least as important as prior experience.

A technical master's degree (or you will graduate in the upcoming months), preferably within a strong technical direction like Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Mechanical or Electrical/Industrial Engineering or Econometrics.
Experience with data analysis methodologies, tools and techniques.
Ability to apply modern analytical and statistical approaches to complex business problems.
Experience with tools such as Python, Databricks, Power BI, Spotfire and/or Alteryx.
Business sensitivity and ability to make the step from theoretical models to creating business impact

Skills

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.

To thrive in this job as business analyst, you bring:

Strong capability for problem solving.
Perseverance to ‘find the needle in the haystack’.
Able to work effective and constructive in multidisciplinary teams.
Strong communication and presentation skills, enabling you to explain analytical concepts to various audiences.
A structured and accurate way of working with a focus on quality and efficiency.
Pragmatic, pro-active, ‘self-propelling’ way of working and able to operate in a dynamic environment.
Take responsibility: 'say what you do and do what you say'.
Customer focus and the ability to anticipate stakeholder needs.
The ability to connect data, business context, and strategic objectives.

Distributed Analytics Network

This job position is part of the Distributed Analytics Network (DAN), a network consisting of analytics entities (called Analytics Nodes) throughout the different sectors at ASML. The main objective of DAN is to create an aligned way of working across the organization and elevate ASML's analytics capabilities to the next level. Being part of DAN provides exposure to multiple teams, business domains, and stakeholders across ASML, creating unique opportunities for learning, development, and career growth.

Other Information

If this job description sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Please upload your resume and a brief motivation explaining why you are interested in joining ASML and how you can contribute as a Business Analyst.
An online assessment and in-person business case assessment are part of the recruitment process.

U.S. Bank is seeking an experienced Data Analyst
to perform validation on our customer remediation events. This data-driven role performs validation in accordance with the Customer Remediation Policy. Data is pulled from various sources including but not limited to SQL Server, Oracle, Netezza, PostgreSQL, SAS, and others. Credibly challenging data extraction, population verification, and financial calculations

Collaborate with ML engineers to evaluate model performance metrics and experimental results

Attention to detail and a systematic approach to problem-solving

new_jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

U.S. Bank is seeking an experienced and collaborative Business Banking Salesforce Project Manager
to help shape the future of our Business Banking Customer Relationship Management (BCRM) Salesforce platform. This role serves as a critical bridge between business stakeholders, sales leaders, product strategy teams, and technology partners, driving platform enhancements that help bankers better serve clients, deepen relationships, and grow business outcomes.

The Business Banking Salesforce platform supports thousands of bankers and business banking professionals across the organization and is a strategic investment area focused on innovation, growth, and continuous improvement. This is not a traditional PMO project management role. Instead, we are seeking a business-minded problem solver who enjoys understanding complex business challenges, gathering and translating requirements, and delivering technology-enabled solutions that improve user experience, streamline processes, and create meaningful business value.

In this highly visible role, you will influence how bankers manage customer relationships, portfolios, sales opportunities, and daily activities while partnering with leaders across Sales, Product, and Technology to help drive the evolution of a platform that is central to the success of Business Banking at U.S. Bank.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the prioritization, planning, design, and implementation of enhancements and capabilities within the Business Banking Salesforce platform.
Partner with business leaders, sales teams, product managers, and technology partners to understand business objectives and translate them into actionable solutions.
Facilitate requirements gathering, stakeholder discussions, business process analysis, and solution design activities.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, user experience, and business outcomes through Salesforce capabilities and platform enhancements.
Coordinate cross-functional initiatives from concept through implementation, ensuring successful delivery and stakeholder alignment.
Manage project plans, timelines, dependencies, risks, issues, and communications throughout the project lifecycle.
Support user adoption, training, change management, and continuous improvement efforts.
Ensure platform enhancements align with business strategy, customer needs, and organizational priorities.
Serve as a trusted advisor and key liaison between business and technology teams, translating business needs into scalable platform solutions.
Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Business Banking, Sales, Product, Operations, and Technology to drive successful outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with Salesforce CRM or similar enterprise CRM platforms.
Experience supporting Business Banking, Commercial Banking, Sales Enablement, Relationship Management, or Customer Relationship Management functions.
Experience serving in Business Analyst, Product Owner, Platform Delivery Lead, Business Systems Analyst, Salesforce Analyst, or Project Manager roles.
Knowledge of banking products, sales processes, customer lifecycle management, and relationship-based business models.
Salesforce Administrator Certification or related Salesforce certifications.
Experience partnering with cross-functional business and technology teams.
Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into solution recommendations.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and relationship-building skills.
Experience leading platform enhancements, process improvement initiatives, or digital transformation efforts.
Ability to communicate effectively with both business stakeholders and technical teams.
Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
Eight or more years of experience leading complex business, technology, platform, or transformation initiatives

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Project Manager

Location: Brooklyn, New York, United States

Industry: Construction

Work Setting: Hybrid

Are you passionate about leading complex construction projects, driving operational excellence, and delivering high-quality results that exceed customer expectations?
We are seeking an experienced Construction Project Manager to oversee residential, commercial, and union construction projects from planning through completion. This role requires strong leadership, project execution expertise, and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Execution

Lead end-to-end management of residential, commercial, and union construction projects.
Develop, maintain, and execute project schedules, budgets, and resource plans.
Coordinate project activities to ensure efficient and successful project delivery.
Monitor progress and proactively address challenges that impact timelines, costs, or quality.
Ensure projects are completed in accordance with contractual requirements and client expectations.

Construction Operations

Oversee daily field operations and project execution activities.
Coordinate material procurement, deliveries, workforce scheduling, and subcontractor activities.
Maintain smooth project workflows across multiple active job sites.
Ensure project teams have the resources necessary to achieve operational objectives.
Manage shifting priorities while maintaining productivity and efficiency.

Stakeholder & Client Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, subcontractors, union representatives, and field personnel.
Act as the primary point of contact for project-related communications and issue resolution.
Facilitate effective collaboration between project stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.
Provide regular project updates and maintain high levels of customer satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

Monitor project quality standards and ensure compliance with design specifications, industry standards, and contractual requirements.
Conduct regular site reviews and inspections to verify workmanship and project quality.
Identify and resolve construction discrepancies, field issues, and technical concerns.
Promote a culture of accountability, safety, and excellence across project teams.

Budget & Financial Management

Manage project budgets, forecasts, and job cost control activities.
Track project expenses and identify opportunities to improve financial performance.
Review contracts, change orders, and subcontract agreements to ensure cost control and risk mitigation.
Monitor project profitability and support financial reporting activities.

Problem Solving & Risk Management

Identify project risks and develop proactive mitigation strategies.
Resolve site conflicts, technical challenges, and operational issues efficiently.
Manage project changes while minimizing schedule and budget impacts.
Apply strong problem-solving skills to support successful project outcomes.

Reporting & Performance Monitoring

Provide ongoing reporting related to project schedules, milestones, budgets, and operational performance.
Track project KPIs and communicate status updates to leadership and stakeholders.
Maintain accurate project documentation and records.
Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance project delivery effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience managing construction projects from initiation through completion.
Demonstrated success delivering residential, commercial, and union construction projects.
Strong knowledge of construction practices, project scheduling, budgeting, and cost management.
Ability to read and interpret blueprints, drawings, specifications, and contracts.
Experience managing subcontractors, field crews, and multiple project stakeholders.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
Strong organizational and time-management capabilities.
Valid driver's license and willingness to travel within project territories as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
10+ years of construction project management experience.
Experience working in high-volume construction environments.
Knowledge of union labor agreements and construction workforce management.
Familiarity with regional construction standards, codes, and regulations.
Experience with project management software and construction technology platforms.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
A busy construction company in the Morris County area is seeking a Construction Project Manager to join their growing company. This Construction Project Manager will get the chance to work for a growing team that needs senior leadership to help drive growth and set the standard. The ideal Construction Project Manager will have 5+ years in civil construction, be local to the Morris County area, and be someone who can direct projects from early planning through final closeout while maintaining control of cost, schedule, safety, and quality. This Construction Project Manager offers the chance to work closely with clients, subcontractors, and field leadership to deliver complex work efficiently and profitably. Other responsibilities of this Construction Project Manager will include but not be limited to:

Construction Project Manager Responsibilities:
• Direct civil construction assignments from initial planning and procurement through completion and closeout.
• Build and update project timelines, cost plans, forecasts, and control measures to keep work progressing as expected.
• Oversee project financial results by managing billing, change documentation, job cost tracking, and margin performance.
• Collaborate with owners, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, and onsite teams to keep communication clear and decisions timely.
• Examine drawings, technical specifications, contract documents, and defined scopes to confirm project expectations and execution plans.
• Lead subcontractor and vendor engagement, including solicitation, negotiations, contract administration, and performance oversight.
• Anticipate schedule impacts, budget concerns, and scope changes, then implement solutions to reduce project risk.
• Manage project records such as RFIs, submittals, change requests, meeting notes, and closeout documentation.
• Partner with superintendents and field personnel to maintain alignment on production goals, safety standards, and quality expectations.
• Support estimating, proposal development, and other preconstruction or business growth efforts when needed.

This Construction Project Manager role is paying between $100,000 and $150,000 annually depending on experience. If interested in this Construction Project Manager position, apply today!

• At least 5 years of project management experience, with strong preference for professionals who have led civil construction projects.
• Demonstrated success guiding projects from kickoff through final completion.
• Solid knowledge of civil or site construction practices, such as excavation, utilities, concrete, grading, drainage, or infrastructure work.
• Experience managing project budgets, cost controls, forecasting, and overall financial performance.
• Ability to interpret plans, specifications, contracts, and other construction-related documents accurately.
• Strong communication, negotiation, and coordination skills across clients, subcontractors, and internal teams.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction or project management software platforms.
• Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.
